name: 找地方
description: 在 TREK 里直接搜遍高德地图——餐厅、景点、宝藏小店都能找，一键复制详情或添加进当前行程，坐标/地图链接/电话自动带上。Search Amap POIs inside TREK & add them to your trip in one click.
author: imusic-487

settings.label: 界面语言 / Interface language
settings.hint: 选择插件页面使用的语言 / Choose the language used by the plugin page

settings.label: 高德 Web 服务 Key / Amap Web Service Key
settings.placeholder: 申请自 console.amap.com（Web 服务类型）/ Get one at console.amap.com (Web Service)

settings.label: 修复坐标：每批并发请求数 / Fix coordinates: requests per batch

options.label: 5（最快，需高德 Key 配额充裕 / fastest; requires sufficient Amap Key quota）

settings.hint: 数值越大扫描越快，但会同时发更多请求给高德——如果 Key 触发限流就调低 / Higher values scan faster but send more simultaneous requests to Amap; lower this if your Key is rate-limited.

settings.label: 修复坐标：优先按原坐标周边搜索 / Fix coordinates: search near the original location first

options.label: 开启（默认）——围绕地点原坐标搜索 / On (default) — search around the original location
关闭——只按名称搜索 / Off — search by name only

settings.hint: 防止同名地点（连锁店、跨区同名点）被匹配错——地点已有坐标时围绕原坐标就近搜索 / Helps prevent incorrect matches for places with the same name by searching near an existing coordinate.

settings.label: 修复坐标：周边搜索半径（米）/ Fix coordinates: nearby-search radius (m)
settings.hint: 仅在上方开关开启时生效。半径内搜不到匹配结果的地点会跳过，不猜测坐标 / Applies only when the option above is on. Places without a match in the radius are skipped; coordinates are never guessed.
